identity.name: Monoammonium glutamate
identity.chemical_class: ammonium salt of L-glutamic acid (amino-acid salt)

function.mechanism: Provides glutamate taste signaling (umami/savoury) and can intensify salty perception in reduced-sodium formulations.

adi.basis: EFSA 2017 group ADI for glutamic acid and glutamates (E620-E625).

efsa.key_finding: EFSA set a group ADI and concluded dietary exposure may exceed the ADI (and, for highly exposed younger groups, doses linked to some adverse human effects), recommending review of maximum permitted levels.

adi.basis: WHO/JECFA lists ADI NOT SPECIFIED for monoammonium L-glutamate within the L-glutamate salt group.

concerns.summary: Recent rat neurotoxicity models reported biochemical and histological brain changes under high-dose MSG exposure paradigms.
Rodent studies reported reproductive hormone suppression and sperm/testicular effects in high-dose or combined inflammatory exposure models.
Allergy-focused reviews report sporadic intolerance-like reactions but little consistent evidence for true IgE-mediated MSG allergy at realistic intakes.

no_concern_confirmed: EFSA and FDA continue to allow glutamate additive use under defined conditions.
JECFA maintains an ADI 'not specified' group position for L-glutamate salts.
A major review found many reported hazards rely on high-dose or methodologically limited studies with weak direct relevance to typical dietary exposure.

adi_exceedance.notes: EFSA refined exposure assessment for glutamate additives reported potential exceedance of the 30 mg/kg bw/day group ADI in several populations.

risk_assessment.rationale: E624 is still permitted by major authorities, but EFSA established a finite group ADI and identified exceedance risks in younger/high-intake populations. Recent rodent studies suggest hazard signals at elevated doses, while human evidence at realistic intake remains mixed and often methodologically limited.
key_factors: EFSA group ADI of 30 mg/kg bw/day with exceedance concerns
FDA GRAS listing in 21 CFR 182.1500 with GMP condition
